# Whacky Auctions

> Whacky Auctions is a South African online auction platform based in Florida, Gauteng. Listings use real item photos, clear condition notes, transparent opening bids and a fair two-minute soft close.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.whackyauctions.co.za/): Overview of Whacky Auctions.
- [Auctions](https://www.whackyauctions.co.za/auctions): Live, upcoming and preview auction items.
- [How it works](https://www.whackyauctions.co.za/how-it-works): Bidder activation, bidding, soft-close, payment and collection process.
- [About](https://www.whackyauctions.co.za/about): Background and operating principles.
- [Contact](https://www.whackyauctions.co.za/contact): Customer support and information-officer contact details.
- [Early access](https://www.whackyauctions.co.za/join): Registration for auction launch updates.
- [Legal centre](https://www.whackyauctions.co.za/legal): Auction rules, terms, privacy and compliance documents.

## Important information

- Currency: South African rand (ZAR).
- Location: Florida, Gauteng, South Africa.
- Contact: info@whackyauctions.co.za.
- Auction item condition and collection requirements are disclosed on each listing.
- Bidding is subject to bidder activation and the published auction rules.
